propositions: RemoteRef.instance field is never constructed in production code and remains unpopulated despite being documented as the deployment identity value
The Backend port declares no remote_ref() method, but the test fake FakeBackend implements it, creating an asymmetry where contract tests pass against a capability not exposed by real backends
instance derived from configured base URL and injected at backend construction satisfies observability of deployment identity without persisting RemoteRef or requiring operator configuration
RemoteRef.instance does not prevent local ticket ID collision between same-vendor deployments because _jira_key_to_local_id derives IDs from Jira keys alone, independent of instance value
Vendor field already separates Cloud ("jira") from DataCenter ("jira-datacenter"), so instance disambiguates only multiple deployments of the same vendor
ADR claims about instance preventing collision must be amended to reflect actual behavior where vendor provides Cloud/DC separation and local ID scheme remains instance-agnostic
